title: Runner access limitations: HLTV and several esportsbook pages refuse automated requests; absence of a page result is not proof no market exists
detail: The 2026-10-22T07:39:57Z GitHub Actions runner sweep was read-only. HLTV matches and ranking returned HTTP 403 with Cloudflare challenge markers; BetBoom 401, Stake 403, Marathonbet 403 and EGamersWorld 403. GG.BET changed from 403 to HTTP 200 on the second run but served challenge markers and no target fixture prices. DraftKings, OddsPortal and BC.Game answered 200 but no target fixture's two-sided prematch series price was extracted. Pinnacle's guest esports matchup API returned 16,201 rows but none of the 18 target fixtures. These are access/extraction limitations, not proof that no book lists a fixture; all model-only rows remain explicitly labelled as research estimates and are retried on the scheduled refresh. The exact per-source response and timestamps are in the linked runner JSON.

title: bo3.gg relayed a two-sided Thunderpick quote for 6yuBoJlbl vs ex-6666; keep it as a lead until the first-party ladder replays it
